props.name: data
props.description: The root. Its label is printed in the centre until you zoom in.

props.name: depth
props.description: Rings drawn outward from the node in focus. Deeper levels appear as you zoom.

props.name: size
props.description: Largest rendered size in pixels. The chart shrinks with its container.

props.name: format
props.description: Format values in the centre, tooltip and hidden list.

props.name: valueLabel
props.description: What a value measures, for the tooltip — “Spend”, “Size”.

props.name: onZoom
props.description: Called when the chart zooms, with the id of the node now in the centre.
